Dubai end-of-term12-month eviction grounds are separate from30-day nonpayment notice and90-day renewal-amendment notice.
DLD/RDC FAQ text describes deposit collection as mandatory; actual legislation and DLD case explanation say the landlord may collect. No mandatory deposit claim copied.

Construction Article234 is a general remedy route, not a complete warranty or construction-law review.

Current general PersonalStatus Article8 makes family-guidance referral discretionary where feasible and lists exceptions; government divorce overview calls it mandatory and mixes civil custody material with a Sharia heading. Operative law used instead of those conflicting overview statements.
